Its Implementation folder holds the game-specific wiring (hotkeys, floor setup, notification mediator), as in NotificationSystem, and it binds exactly keys 1–5. A's SystemPackage requires its Implementation rules module and hard-codes the notification, it binds keys up to 9, and it changes a shared utility. A's testable rules module and spec are good, but supporting specs don't count under criterion 7.
